assertions.name: offset_angle_is_not_an_invariant_under_D
assertions.source: the separation sweeps [0.000899028, 2.10987] rad as the representative t varies over [-1000, 1000] — a span of 2.10897 rad out of pi. It is a function of the choice of point on the solution line, not of the braid pair.

assertions.name: C_frame_value_is_reachable_by_choosing_the_representative
assertions.source: the committed C-frame separation 0.3551189675 rad lies inside [0.000899028, 2.10987]. So agreement between the frames could be manufactured and disagreement means nothing — the comparison carries no information either way. This is why the probe reports no D-frame offset angle.

assertions.name: t_independent_reading_only_restates_the_min_norm_choice
assertions.source: projecting off v and then off P(1) gives one identical value at every t tested out to 1e3. But projecting off v IS the min-norm selection, so the invariance is the choice restated, not removed. An earlier pass of this probe claimed the SINGLE projection was t-independent 'by construction'; that was wrong — v is orthogonal to P(1), so it leaves the t*v component untouched — and the sweep is what caught it.

description: Re-poses qbeta_braid_nf_sdp_offset's demand on the convention-D quotient H_3(q)/rad and finds the offset ANGLE IS NOT AN INVARIANT. Under D, G x = P(nf) has solution set x_0 + t*v for all real t (G v = 0), and the C-frame probe never imposed its net constraint as an input (it read the net off as an output), so t is free. Measured: the separation angle sweeps [0.000899, 2.10987] rad over t in [-1000, 1000] — essentially all of (0, pi). The committed C-frame value 0.355119 rad lies INSIDE that range, reachable by picking t ~ +/-2.2, so 'does D reproduce C' is not a meaningful question. A t-independent reading exists (project off v, then off the symmetric direction P(1): 2.10986587031 rad at every t out to 1e3) but only because projecting off v IS the min-norm selection — the choice restated, and a Euclidean one at that, on top of a metric the C-frame witness already listed under untried_not_excluded. D needs two choices where C needed none. Also measured: the nf vectors are convention-INDEPENDENT (they fold with h = q - 1/q, no z; committed C-frame nf matches the D recomputation to 8.5e-22), so what moved between frames is G alone. CONSEQUENCE: the C-frame homogeneity_broken=true at 0.355119 rad was well-defined ONLY because G is invertible under C. Scope-(a): the measurement stands in its own frame; what is withdrawn is its portability to D. NOT attempted: choosing a canonical metric (the G-induced form on the quotient is the natural candidate) — picking a metric to make an angle come out is a fit. No value wired, no tier moved.

data.solution_set: x_0 + t*v for all real t (G v = 0)
